title: Manage Warehouses
readerIntent: Configure stock-holding and fulfillment locations with flexible service scopes.
priorKnowledge: Know enterprise locations, zones, Stores, segments, purposes, and sourcing policy.
summary: Warehouses hold balances and serve configurable scopes; they are not limited to one country/zone hierarchy.

sections.heading: Configure
items: Stable code, tenant, enterprise, location, timezone, active state, type, capacity, purposes, and operational calendar.
Countries, zones, areas, postal ranges, Stores, channels, customer segments, pickup/delivery roles, priority, exclusions, and fallback.
Validate overlap/ambiguity, cross-tenant links, inactive locations, unsupported units, and source capacity.
A physical Store may be linked as pickup/fulfillment while Store and Inventory retain separate ownership.
